The '''Halm sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the southwestern [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It bordered the [[Oriolan sector/Legends|Oriolan]], [[Masla sector/Legends|Masla]] and [[Tashtor sector/Legends|Tashtor sectors]] in the Mid Rim, as well as the [[Jidlor Marches/Legends|Jidlor Marches]].
